hints.title: Suffix Template Cost
hints.text: Each split chunk receives a formatted index tag <i/b>. Its character length is len(str(i)) + len(str(b)) + 3.

hints.title: Minimal Capacity Search
hints.text: Iterate b upwards starting from 1. If limit <= 2 * len(str(b)) + 3, no message payload can fit.

hints.title: Exact Capacity Verification
hints.text: Accumulate the total characters consumed by all i from 1 to b. As soon as total capacity exceeds or matches message length, construct the resulting chunks.

hints.title: Linear Search Chunk Extraction Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def splitMessage(self, message: str, limit: int) -> list[str]:
        n = len(message)
        cur_sum_len = 0
        for b in range(1, n + 1):
            d = len(str(b))
            cur_sum_len += len(str(b))
            if limit <= d + 3 + d:
                continue
            cap = b * (limit - 3 - d) - cur_sum_len
            if cap >= n:
                ans = []
                idx = 0
                for i in range(1, b + 1):
                    suffix = f"<{i}/{b}>"
                    msg_len = limit - len(suffix)
                    ans.append(message[idx:idx + msg_len] + suffix)
                    idx += msg_len
                return ans
        return []
```

complexity.notes: Testing b up to n takes linear time, and chunk extraction copies characters once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating string concatenation for every candidate b creates quadratic overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) space to hold split chunks.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Formulates chunk capacity mathematically to identify optimal b before slicing.
